summary: Every one of the PRD's 8 acceptance criteria is implemented and reachable from its entry point: the batch rows on the phase plan, the audit and batch names on every surface, the loop wording with its maximum, the Audit loops help text and kiln status in text and JSON. One round of four fresh assessors found no gap, and a search of the source finds no remaining "loop n of limit" wording. No completion phase was needed; the test audit comes next.
